metadata.fallback_strategy: Multi-level selector hierarchy (name → id → label text)
metadata.notes: Portal uses standard HTML elements. No React/Vue/Angular framework detected.

competencia.label: Competência da NFS-e
competencia.fallback: Select field with label text matching 'Competência'
competencia.notes: Standard select field. Name attribute is reliable.

cnpj_tomador.label: CNPJ / CPF / NIF do Tomador
cnpj_tomador.fallback: Input field with label text matching 'CNPJ / CPF / NIF'
cnpj_tomador.notes: Critical field. Name attribute is stable. Placeholder may contain 'CNPJ'.

nome_tomador.label: Nome / Nome Empresarial do Tomador
nome_tomador.fallback: Input field with label text matching 'Nome' or 'Nome Empresarial'
nome_tomador.notes: Standard text input. Name attribute is primary.

endereco_tomador.label: Endereço do Tomador
endereco_tomador.fallback: Input field with label text matching 'Endereço'
endereco_tomador.notes: Standard text input. May have autocomplete feature.

municipio_tomador.label: Município do Tomador
municipio_tomador.fallback: Input field with label text matching 'Município'
municipio_tomador.notes: Standard text input. May have autocomplete.

cep_tomador.label: CEP do Tomador
cep_tomador.fallback: Input field with label text matching 'CEP'
cep_tomador.notes: Standard text input. May trigger address lookup on blur.

local_prestacao.label: Local da Prestação
local_prestacao.fallback: Input field with label text matching 'Local' or 'Prestação'
local_prestacao.notes: Standard text input. May have autocomplete for municipalities.

valor_servico.label: Valor do Serviço
valor_servico.fallback: Input field with label text matching 'Valor'
valor_servico.notes: Currency input. May have masking. Inject numeric string (1800.00), script handles formatting.

injection_testing.expected_result: Each selector should return a non-null HTMLElement
if_returns_null: 1. Verify portal page is fully loaded
2. Check if page uses Shadow DOM (inspect element tree)
3. Check if page uses dynamic rendering (wait 2-3s after page load)
4. Use browser DevTools to find the actual selector
5. Update this file with the correct selector

portal_analysis.form_rendering: Dynamic (form may load after initial page load, handled by MutationObserver in content.js)
portal_analysis.event_handlers: Standard DOM events (input, change, blur, focus)
portal_analysis.selectors_stability: HIGH - Name attributes are stable across portal updates
